achievements.name: All Multipliers
achievements.desc: Use M01 through M20 at least once.

achievements.name: All Rebirths
achievements.desc: Use R01 through R12 at least once.

achievements.name: All Higher Resets
achievements.desc: Use every Ultra, Prestige, and Ascension button.

achievements.name: Quick Rebirth
achievements.desc: After unlocking Ultra, perform a Rebirth within 60 seconds of the previous Rebirth.

achievements.name: Quick Ultra
achievements.desc: Perform an Ultra Rebirth within 5 minutes of the previous Ultra-cycle start.

achievements.name: Quick Prestige
achievements.desc: Perform a Prestige within 15 minutes of the current Prestige cycle.

achievements.name: Manual Prestige
achievements.desc: Complete a full Prestige cycle without using automation.

achievements.name: Exact Rebirth
achievements.desc: Use a Rebirth button with no more than 5% excess Multiplier.

achievements.name: Exact Ultra
achievements.desc: Use an Ultra button with no more than 5% excess Rebirth.

achievements.name: Back to Basics
achievements.desc: After your first Ultra, earn a Rebirth using only Area 1 Multiplier buttons during that Rebirth cycle.

achievements.name: Clean Ultra
achievements.desc: After automation is unlocked, complete an Ultra cycle without using automation.

achievements.name: Lifetime Economy
achievements.desc: Earn 1e60 total Cash across all runs.

secrets.name: Behind the Numbers
secrets.clue: The first reset platform has a back side too.
secrets.concept: A side gap behind the R01 landmark leads to a small hidden plate. No jump exploit required.

secrets.name: Against the Flow
secrets.clue: Not every arrow should be followed.
secrets.concept: The Area2 return lane is visually one-way. Walking against its arrows reaches a maintenance alcove with a secret plate.

secrets.name: Echo Sequence
secrets.clue: Four symbols repeat the same story.
secrets.concept: Four non-economic secret plates sit near the Rebirth row. A nearby mural gives a four-symbol order. Wrong input resets only the puzzle.

secrets.name: Second Look
secrets.concept: After the first Ultra, a previously dark panel on the back of the original R01 landmark lights up. Returning to Area1 reveals the plate.

secrets.name: False Face
secrets.clue: One wall panel does not match the others.
secrets.concept: A wall/trim module in Area3 has a deliberately inverted motif. A walkable side opening behind it leads to the secret; no fake collision trick on the main route.

secrets.name: Long Way Around
secrets.clue: The visible button is not reached from the front.
secrets.concept: A secret plate is visible through glass from the main route. The player must follow a short alternate return path around the Automation landmark.

secrets.name: Relay
secrets.clue: Three small lights belong to one circuit.
secrets.concept: Three persistent switches, one each in Areas 2, 3, and 4. No timer. Activating all three opens a small terminal beside Area4's landmark.

secrets.name: Completion Seal
secrets.clue: Seven marks fit around the final seal.
secrets.concept: Area5 contains a visible sealed pedestal from first entry. It opens only after first Ascension and the other seven Secrets.

persistentHUD.desktop: Top-left compact unlocked-stat stack; top-center objective pill; top-right Menu + Quick Travel when unlocked.
persistentHUD.mobile: Safe-inset top stat stack; objective pill centered below topbar; one Menu button and optional Quick Travel, no lower-corner control clutter.

achievementPresentation.lockedHidden: Show ??? title/description for hidden achievements until earned.
achievementPresentation.simultaneousAwards: Combine multiple awards/unlocks into one summary toast.

collectionPresentation.lockedState: Silhouette + area/unlock hint; do not reveal distant exact cost before its area unlocks.
collectionPresentation.discoveredState: Button icon, ID, best known cost/reward, first-used marker.

secretPresentation.beforeHintFeature: Area only for non-hidden clues; exact solution never shown.
secretPresentation.afterHintFeature: One vague clue line per unlocked secret.
secretPresentation.found: Show emblem, name, reward, found date/session optional.

Area1.grammar: Spawn enters a shallow fan. M01-M03 left arc, M04-M06 right arc, R01 raised/outlined at the far focal point, Area2 gate behind/offset from R01.

Area2.grammar: M07-M11 on one side, R02-R08 on the opposite stepped/segmented row, U01 as the far landmark; return lane closes the horseshoe.

Area3.grammar: Central Ultra landmark or void defines orientation. M12-M14 on outer arc, R09-R10 inside, U02-U04 opposite, P01 at the next focal point.

Area4.grammar: Automation landmark in the center splits traffic. Multi wing and reset wing reconnect at Prestige row; A01 is visible beyond as the long-term objective.

Area5.grammar: Endgame court with three short wings. A02-A04 form the dominant arc. Completion Seal is visible but closed until S08 requirements are met.
